title: Jehu Anointed King of Israel

questions.question: Who did Elisha send to anoint Jehu?
options: One of the sons of the prophets
questions.correctAnswer: One of the sons of the prophets
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:1 (ESV): "Then Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets and said to him..."

questions.question: Where was Jehu when he was anointed?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:1, 4 (ESV): "...Go to Ramoth-gilead... So the young man... went to Ramoth-gilead."

questions.question: What mission was given to Jehu?
options: Strike down the house of Ahab
questions.correctAnswer: Strike down the house of Ahab
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:7 (ESV): "And you shall strike down the house of Ahab your master..."

questions.question: How was Jehu known to drive his chariot?
How did Jezebel die?
options: She was thrown out of a window and trampled by horses
questions.correctAnswer: She was thrown out of a window and trampled by horses
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:33 (ESV): "...So they threw her down. And some of her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses, and they trampled on her."

questions.question: What did Jehu do to Joram (Jehoram)?
options: Shot him with an arrow between the shoulders
questions.correctAnswer: Shot him with an arrow between the shoulders
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:24 (ESV): "And Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and shot Joram between the shoulders..."

questions.question: Where did Joram's body land?
options: On the plot of ground of Naboth the Jezreelite
questions.correctAnswer: On the plot of ground of Naboth the Jezreelite
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:25 (ESV): "...cast him on the plot of ground of Naboth the Jezreelite."

questions.question: Who was with Joram when Jehu came?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:21 (ESV): "So Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot..."

questions.question: What did Jezebel do when she heard Jehu was coming?
options: Painted her eyes and adorned her head
questions.correctAnswer: Painted her eyes and adorned her head
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:30 (ESV): "...she painted her eyes and adorned her head and looked out of the window."

questions.question: What happened to Jezebel's body after she died?
options: She was buried in a tomb
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:35-36 (ESV): "But when they went to bury her, they found no more of her than the skull... The dogs shall eat the flesh of Jezebel..."

questions.question: What question did Jehu repeatedly ask the horsemen sent to him?
options: What do you have to do with peace? Turn behind me
questions.correctAnswer: What do you have to do with peace? Turn behind me
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:18, 19 (ESV): "...What do you have to do with peace? Turn behind me."

questions.question: Who threw Jezebel down?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:32-33 (ESV): "...And two or three eunuchs looked out at him. He said, 'Throw her down.' So they threw her down."

questions.question: Where did Ahaziah die?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:27 (ESV): "...And he fled to Megiddo and died there."

questions.question: What did Jezebel call Jehu?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:31 (ESV): "...Is it peace, you Zimri, murderer of your master?"

questions.question: What was found of Jezebel?
options: The skull, feet, and palms of her hands
questions.correctAnswer: The skull, feet, and palms of her hands
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 9:35 (ESV): "...they found no more of her than the skull and the feet and the palms of her hands."

key_verse_text: And you shall strike down the house of Ahab your master, so that I may avenge on Jezebel the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD. (ESV)
